question: Among the dated events in the timeline, which two ministerial posts did Clark take up most recently during the Fourth Labour Government?
criterion: Clark taking up a ministerial portfolio or the Deputy Prime Minister post, during the Fourth Labour Government.
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là hai nhiệm vụ nội các được nhận sau cùng trong Chính phủ Lao động thứ tư, nên cần ít nhất ba mốc nhận nhiệm vụ để phân biệt mốc trước cuối với mốc cuối.

gold_events.text: Became Minister of Health
Became Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Labour

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the opposition posts Clark took up from becoming Deputy Leader of the Opposition until the first general election she faced as Opposition leader.
criterion: The start of a post Clark took up in the opposition (Deputy Leader, Leader of the Opposition, or a shadow portfolio), within the window.
why_needs_multiple: Câu tóm tắt cần ba chức vụ đối lập được nhận trong một giai đoạn hẹp, nên không thể trả lời bằng một mốc đơn lẻ.

gold_events.text: Became Deputy Leader of the Opposition and shadow spokesperson
Became Leader of the Opposition and Labour Party leader
Took shadow foreign affairs portfolio

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, which change in her membership of Labour's national executive committee came immediately after she left it?
criterion: A change in Clark's membership of Labour's national executive committee (joining, leaving or rejoining it).
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là thay đổi kế tiếp sau khi rời ban chấp hành, nên cần ít nhất hai thay đổi tư cách thành viên để xác định thứ tự.

gold_events.text: Left Labour national executive committee
Rejoined Labour national executive committee

label: official visit
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the overseas trips that the text describes as visits, in time order.
criterion: Trips abroad that the timeline text describes as a visit.
why_needs_multiple: Câu liệt kê cần năm chuyến đi nước ngoài được gọi là chuyến thăm có ngày, để kiểm độ đầy đủ theo thứ tự thời gian.

gold_events.text: Official visit to Beijing; met President Jiang Zemin
First visit to United States as PM; Pentagon and Washington visits
Attended Armistice Day service in Hyde Park, London
Visited United States and met George W. Bush in Washington
Visited Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone over Ebola prevention

label: award
question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the awards and honours Clark received from the time she became Prime Minister onward, in time order.
criterion: An award or honour conferred on Clark, counted from the time she became Prime Minister onward.
why_needs_multiple: Câu liệt kê cần bảy giải thưởng có ngày sau khi làm thủ tướng, nên phải đối chiếu nhiều mốc để kiểm độ đầy đủ.

gold_events.text: Presented with Nuclear-Free Future Award
Awarded Star of the Solomon Islands with John Howard
Won UNEP Champions of the Earth award
Honorary Doctor of Laws from University of Auckland
Appointed Member of the Order of New Zealand
Received Lifetime Achievement Award at NZ Women of Influence Awards
Awarded Grand Cordon of the Order of the Rising Sun

question: By calendar year, how many years passed from Clark being elected to Parliament for Mount Albert to her being sworn in as Prime Minister?
criterion: The gap in calendar years between two named role events: election to Parliament and swearing-in as Prime Minister.
why_needs_multiple: Câu hỏi khoảng cách cần hai mốc có năm để tính hiệu số năm theo năm lịch.

gold_events.text: Elected to Parliament for Mount Albert electorate
Sworn in as 37th Prime Minister of New Zealand
